limitations.quote: // The final 0 can start another match, even across invalid cycles.
limitations.note: The agent fixed the duplicate state encoding but also changed the post-match transitions to retain the final zero, allowing overlapping matches where the original FSM would return to idle.
The exhaustive test used a rolling history that assumed overlapping matches were correct, so it passed without catching the regression in the original post-match behavior.
Two patch attempts failed to match the file’s whitespace, and the fallback used an unavailable Python command and tried Git outside a repository, forcing another edit attempt.
